subject: Capacity prioritization: Stratify AI surge window (May-Jun)
messages:
From: Julia Morris <julia.morris@stratify.ai>
To: priyom.das@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-29T08:14:00Z
Subject: Dedicated capacity sizing: upcoming surge window

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. We have a firm launch window for a new feature that will drive a ~6x spike in inference traffic for a seven-day period starting June 1. Our preliminary traffic model is attached (CSV) but high level: baseline 400k tokens/day -> peak 2.4M tokens/day during the window.

Given that this is core to our go-to-market, we need a firm plan for dedicated capacity or guaranteed burst lanes. Specifically we are asking: can Redwood provide a temporary prioritized allocation (hard or soft reserve) to avoid tail latency and preemption during 6/1–6/7? We are open to a short-term amendment to our existing Dedicated agreement, and can accept a priced burst/tranche if needed.

Our procurement and engineering leads are on this thread: procure@stratify.ai and Anil (ops). Please advise what information you need from our side to get this prioritized.

Appreciate rapid help here — this is time sensitive.

Best,
Julia Morris
Head of Platform
Stratify AI

Attachments: stratify-traffic-projection.csv
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Julia Morris <julia.morris@stratify.ai>
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-29T09:07:00Z
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity sizing: upcoming surge window

Julia — thanks for the heads-up and for the projection. We can support you but I need to coordinate internal commitments and confirm impacts to other reserved deals.

Could you confirm the time windows (UTC), peak qps and whether traffic is latency-sensitive (p99SLO target)? Also, do you expect sustained GPU-bound inference or batched job processing? That helps determine whether to use dedicated tranche, burst lane, or temporary preemption protection.

I’m looping in our Capacity & Sales Ops leads (Marcus, Laura, Vivek) — we’ll aim to give you an option set and recommended tradeoffs by end of day tomorrow. If you have any hard constraints (absolute SLO or no preemption), flag them now.

— Priyom
Senior Account Lead, Dedicated
Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: marcus.lin@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-29T10:20:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Dedicated capacity sizing: upcoming surge window — need options by EOD

Forwarding Julia's ask. TL;DR: Stratify needs prioritized allocation for 6/1–6/7, ~6x token spike, wants guaranteed behavior during their launch window. They are open to a priced amendment.

Please review and propose 2–3 options (constrained to what the fleet can support):
- Minimal guaranteed (lowest-cost) — what is the smallest guaranteed slice we can give without SLA risk?
- Hybrid (guarantee + preemptible burst) — recommended tradeoffs and cost delta.
- Hard reserve (if feasible) — impact on other reserves and deals, who needs to be informed.

Marcus: can you confirm current dedicated headroom in us-west clusters and whether we can carve a soft reserve? Laura: flag any conflicts with existing reserved commits (Aurora, Nimbus, etc.). Vivek/Ben: ops cost and runbook changes to support a short-term tranche. Monica: any pricing concession precedent we should mirror?

Need internal proposal by 1700 PT.

— Priyom
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: priyom.das@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-29T12:35:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Dedicated capacity sizing: upcoming surge window — need options by EOD

On Fri, May 29, 2027 at 10:20 AM Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com> wrote:
> Forwarding Julia's ask. TL;DR: Stratify needs prioritized allocation for 6/1–6/7, ~6x token spike, wants guaranteed behavior during their launch window.

Team — quick capacity snapshot (us-west fleet):
- Total GPUs in dedicated pool: 720
- Committed reserved (monthly/annual): 560 (across 12 customers)
- Current headroom (non-committed spare): ~80 GPUs (some in burst nodes)
- Planned maintenance 6/2–6/4 (possible 12 GPU impact on availability)

Options based on their ask:
1) Soft-reserve tranche: guarantee 8 GPUs pinned to Stratify during 6/1–6/7 + 40 GPU burst pool (preemptible, 5 min eviction notice). Low risk to SLAs for other customers. Estimated incremental cost: +15% to their monthly committed price for the week.
2) Scheduled batch window: allocate 100 GPUs in a scheduled off-peak tranche for heavy batching (lower per-token cost but requires changes on Stratify side).
3) Hard reserve: carve 48 GPUs guaranteed; high SLA impact and would require rebalancing existing commitments — not recommended unless customer signs a short-term uplift and we coordinate with fairness committee.

I attached a quick plan with utilization sims (capacity-plan-stratify-2027.xlsx). Notes: maintenance window overlaps with peak days; we can shift some maintenance but reduces available headroom by ~12 GPUs.

— Marcus
Capacity Planning Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachments: capacity-plan-stratify-2027.xlsx
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: priyom.das@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-29T15:10:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Dedicated capacity sizing: upcoming surge window — need options by EOD

Adding fairness and commercial perspective. We have two near-term reserved deals (Aurora & Helix) with overlapping burst entitlements in the same cluster. Granting a large hard reserve to Stratify without compensation will trigger an exceptions review. My suggested compromise:
- Offer Option 1 (Marcus's soft-reserve): 8 guaranteed GPUs + 40 preemptible burst.
- Add a priced SLA amendment: 1.5x baseline committed rate for the week for guaranteed tranche, 0.6x baseline rate for preemptible burst.
- Include a one-time credit ($10k) applied to next invoice if we miss p99 latency targets during the window.

Operationally: Ops runbook update required (ops-runbook.txt) and an explicit communications plan for customers who may see degraded tail availability. If Stratify signs the amendment within 24 hours we can lock the soft-reserve and push maintenance to 6/5.

If they insist on a hard reserve >24 GPUs we escalate to the fairness committee; expect 48–72 hour turnaround.

— Laura
Director, Sales Ops & Entitlements
Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Julia Morris <julia.morris@stratify.ai>
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-30T17:06:00Z
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity sizing: upcoming surge window — proposal

Julia — thanks for your patience. After internal review we can offer a short-term allocation that balances your launch risk and our fleet commitments. Summary: 

Agreement (6/1 00:00 UTC — 6/7 23:59 UTC):
- Guaranteed tranche: 8 GPUs pinned to Stratify for the window (non-preemptible).
- Burst pool: up to 40 GPUs preemptible with 5-minute eviction notice.
- Price: guaranteed tranche billed at 1.5x commited rate pro-rata for the week; burst billed at 0.6x on-use.
- SLA safeguard: if p99 tail latency for Stratify exceeds agreed threshold during the window, apply a $10,000 credit to next invoice.

Operational notes: we will postpone non-critical maintenance to 6/5 and update the ops runbook. Marcus will provision the tranche once we receive a signed amendment. I attached the draft amendment (amendment-draft.pdf) and the capacity plan we used to validate headroom.

Next steps:
1) Please review and sign the attached amendment (DocuSign link: https://docusign.company/amend/RDW-STRAT-042) by 2027-05-31 18:00 PT to lock the tranche.
2) If you prefer a larger hard reserve, we can submit an exceptions request to the fairness committee (48–72h decision) but it will require an uplift and explicit rebalancing of other deals.

Happy to hop on a 30m call if you want to run the operational plan.

Best regards,
Priyom Das
Senior Account Lead, Dedicated
Redwood Inference

Attachments: amendment-draft.pdf, capacity-plan-stratify-2027.xlsx, ops-runbook.txt
